name: Toggl Track
whatYouLose: Desktop idle detection and automatic tracking
Browser extension that adds timers into Jira, GitHub, Asana
prompt:
Build a time tracker, a Toggl Track replacement.

Stack: Node + Hono, SQLite, server-rendered HTML with vanilla JS.
Features:
- One-click start/stop timer with description, project, client and tags; manual entry and edit.
- Projects with hourly rates; billable flag per entry.
- Reports: by day/week/month, grouped by project or client, bar chart in inline SVG, CSV and PDF export.
- Generate an invoice draft from billable hours in a date range.
- A tiny CLI (track start "fix bug" -p acme, track stop) hitting the same API.
Done when: I can track a week of work and export a client report.
notes: Start/stop/report is the whole product for freelancers. Agents nail this.
